thesis: The speaker argues that systematic investors should avoid value models because they fail to adapt to changing market environments and often lose money when catching falling knives. Instead, the speaker contends that behavioral signals are the most promising for systematic approaches because human behavior remains constant over time, allowing historical rules to remain valid.
